title: Project Architecture and Maintainable Code
learning_outcomes: Explain the concepts and vocabulary in Project Architecture and Maintainable Code.
Apply an Express.js 5 pattern from Project Architecture and Maintainable Code in a focused local example.
Verify normal behavior and at least one error or boundary case using a repeatable test.

overview_visual.alt_text: Four-step original visual for module 16, Project Architecture and Maintainable Code: Organizing an Express Project, The Controller-Service-Repository Pattern, Separation of Concerns, Dependency Management and Injection; then continue with practice and verification.
